result_text:
I fixed both defects in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/generators/statichtml/LogicalComponentsReportGenerator.java`. `mvn -o -pl reports compile` succeeds, but I added no tests and ran none, so neither fix has been exercised.

1. **Group links:** `getGroupDependencies` handled a reverse-direction dependency by reading the count from the same-direction key, which doesn't exist yet, hence the NullPointerException. It now reads the count from the existing reverse link and adds to it. A 3-file dependency from Group 1 to Group 2 plus a 2-file one back gives one Group 1 → Group 2 link labelled 5.
2. **Zero lines of code:** `getFromDependencyCoverageSvg` now shows 0% when the referring component has no counted lines. The bar chart already enforces a minimum bar width of 1, so the bar stays minimal and no longer overflows.

I didn't commit anything.
